ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB=12\,cm$, $C$ is the midpoint of $AB$, and point $D$ is on segment $AC$, with $AD\colon CB=1\colon 3$, what is the length of $DB$ in $cm$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because$AB=12cm, and C is the midpoint of AB,\\
$\therefore$AC=BC=$\frac{1}{2}$AB=6(cm),\\
$\because$AD$\colon$ CB=1$\colon$ 3,\\
$\therefore$AD=2cm,\\
$\therefore$DC=AC−AD=4(cm),\\
$\therefore$DB=DC+BC=\boxed{10}(cm).
